assembly_context.name: FiveAxisRoboticArm_Assembly
assembly_context.summary: 基于SolidWorks API自动生成一个五轴串联机械臂装配体。包含底座、大臂、小臂、手腕旋转部、末端法兰及5根连接轴。所有连杆简化为带安装凸台的圆柱体，轴为标准圆柱零件。初始姿态为竖直向上伸直状态。
design_rules: All dimensions in mm, convert to meters for modeling code.
Initial pose: All links aligned along +Z axis.
Shafts are standard cylinders, length slightly larger than link width for assembly clearance.
Links are simplified as cylinders with mounting bosses at ends.

instances.name: Link1 (Upper Arm)
instances.placement_notes: Vertical, above Base. Bottom hole mates with J1 Shaft.

instances.name: Link2 (Forearm)
instances.placement_notes: Vertical, above Link1. Bottom hole mates with J2 Shaft.

instances.name: Wrist1 (Wrist Rotate)
instances.placement_notes: Vertical, above Link2. Bottom hole mates with J3 Shaft.

instances.name: Wrist2 (End Effector Flange)
instances.placement_notes: Vertical, above Wrist1. Bottom hole mates with J4 Shaft. Top is free/end.

assembly_sequence: Insert inst_link1, Concentric hole_axis_bottom with inst_shaft_j1.shaft_axis, Coincident end_face_bottom with inst_base.top_face_boss (or offset)
Insert inst_link2, Concentric hole_axis_bottom with inst_shaft_j2.shaft_axis, Coincident end_face_bottom with inst_link1.end_face_top
Insert inst_wrist1, Concentric hole_axis_bottom with inst_shaft_j3.shaft_axis, Coincident end_face_bottom with inst_link2.end_face_top
Insert inst_wrist2, Concentric hole_axis_bottom with inst_shaft_j4.shaft_axis, Coincident end_face_bottom with inst_wrist1.end_face_top

part.name: Generic Arm Link
part.function: Structural link between joints. Used for Link1 (L2), Link2 (L3), Wrist1 (L4), Wrist2 (L5).
part.shape: Cylindrical body with two circular mounting bosses at opposite ends along the longitudinal axis. Body diameter 40mm. Bosses have through-holes for shafts.
key_dimensions: Length varies by instance: L2=200, L3=150, L4=60, L5=40
part.material_or_notes: Aluminum. Length is parameterized per instance.

faces.name: end_face_bottom
faces.purpose: Bottom mounting interface (connects to previous joint/shaft)

faces.name: end_face_top
faces.purpose: Top mounting interface (connects to next joint/shaft)

assembly_relation_notes: Instances differ only by length (extrusion distance).
Bottom hole connects to previous shaft/link.
Top hole connects to next shaft/link.
standalone_modeling_instructions: Sketch circle dia 40mm on XY plane.
On bottom face, sketch circle dia 40mm, extrude cut 10mm deep? No, bosses are additive. Better: Extrude main body. Then add bosses.

Alternative: Sketch profile with bosses included. Or: Extrude cylinder length L. On bottom face, sketch circle dia 40, extrude 10mm down (boss). On top face, sketch circle dia 40, extrude 10mm up (boss).
Cut hole dia 20mm through entire part along Z axis.
